title: Samson, the Lion and the Honey
description: On the way to Timnah, Samson meets a roaring young lion. The Spirit of the Lord comes upon him, and he tears the lion apart with his bare hands without telling his parents. Later, when he returns to fetch the woman, he finds a swarm of bees with honey in the carcass of the lion. He takes the honey, eats it, and also gives some to his parents, but does not reveal where it came from.
